motive: A private collector, Felix Moreau, offered 200,000 for the real painting if a copy was left in its place.
method: Victor came back through the unbadged Side Door at about 21:05 (his phone joined the guest Wi-Fi at 21:04), used the guard's badge, which was left in the front-desk drawer, to open the Vault Room at 21:10, swapped the painting for his copy and left by the Side Door at 21:31.

lies.claim: I was at Celia's flat from 8 PM until midnight, watching the match.
Victor was with me at my flat from 8 PM until midnight.

red_herrings.why: His badge opened the Vault Room at 21:10, but CCTV shows him at the front desk at 21:13; he also complains about pay, and Lucy guesses it was him.
